scope: One hundred complete October 2022 native card bodies reviewed:95 definitions updated and5 retained. Restore attack and spell dispatch, packed attacker iteration, native protection and aura events, mass actions, fixed token colors, extended keyword storage, grave selection/validation, X-cost adjustment, upkeep timing, life-loss and native mana/payment helpers. Original names, interfaces and native quirks retained. Complete assembly confirms packed attacker/count offsets, token fields, extended keyword pointer and energy descriptor; ten compile-time layout/descriptor assertions verify the current source. All native instructions, DWARF contracts, literal/import-thunk bytes,165 enum values,188 callee/callback identities/prototypes and12 complete source dependencies are pinned. Independent callee bodies and gameplay remain separately tracked; no byte matching or whole-program equivalence claim.
